decision: Default OFF; compiled bundle only in renderer_benchmark exports, not ordinary Windows/Android releases. Not a shipped hitch fix.

measured_environment.cold_scope: first action in this process, not a cleared driver/disk shader cache
measured_environment.frame_boundary: process_frame precedes Node._process; game_process_ms is the last completed game frame, and engine/viewport monitors may lag
measured_environment.memory_scope_note: Godot tracked allocation and object/resource counters, not OS working set. Static zero-only samples are unavailable; OS static/peak APIs are probed at runtime and zero is unavailable. Counters may lag frames.
measured_environment.privacy_timing_limit: The opaque mask adds GPU work and can affect culling/overdraw. These are privacy-mode measurements, not unobstructed visible-game FPS.

launch.privacy: Black root guard, Dummy audio, separate never-switched WinSta0 desktops. All before/after active desktop checks Default.

measured_pck.packaging_note: Same PCK used for all four arms. Afterwards export policy was narrowed to benchmark-only; runtime and benchmark semantics unchanged. No binary build artifacts are committed.

memory_interpretation.node_counts: All runs have identical maximum sampled nodes 13771 and final 13357. Repeated survivor setups settle to 13419; lethal setups to 13358. No accumulating candidate-specific nodes observed in this finite run.
memory_interpretation.resources: Initial startup 390; final reference 420/421, candidate 421/422. Both arms grow then largely plateau around 419-422. This does not establish no leak over longer sessions.
memory_interpretation.video_memory: All runs progress from about 703.8 MiB after startup to about 712.4 MiB late. Same workload plateau, not exact OS GPU resident memory.
memory_interpretation.private_memory: Both arms grow over the workload; B2 and A2 share a late elevated-memory period. Endpoint and lifetime peak variation do not isolate a candidate leak or prove cost-free caching.
memory_interpretation.bundle_memory: Serialized payload 49700184 bytes (47.40 MiB), raw image pixel storage 34586624 bytes (32.98 MiB); decoded Dictionary/object overhead is not measured by payload size. Do not add these two as independent memory totals.

gpu_parity.scope: Two full desktop source-board lifecycles, independent mutable resources, fixed 0.05 source clock, seeded source-range click gates. Exact GPU bytes, no tolerance; not original-client or whole-game parity.

validation.pack_freshness: PASS with deliberate stale source-tree bundle; fresh exported blob validated from empty fixture, temporary stale fixture removed
validation.real_privacy_preflight: PASS three black pixel checks including popup and resize

boot_native_attribution.capture: Previous clean Godot 4.7.1 native capture, before this change
boot_native_attribution.caveat: Nested profiled Debug attribution; not additive and not directly comparable to Release durations.
source_caveats: Manifest requests are cached by normalized path; the capture has no path arguments, so exact unique-file count is not established.
Portrait setup includes imported Texture2D.get_image, format/copies/masking/texture creation; not proven raw PNG decoding.

limitations: Privacy-mask measurements only; not unobstructed visible-game FPS.

Boot tracing starts before game construction, not process launch or preloads. First interval includes synchronous setup. Full process lifetime and working set need external observation. Boot-plus-phase samples exclude gaps between measured sections; first-load-plus-startup wall time includes them.
No stutter-free claim; all measured regressions and threshold exceedances are retained.
Percentiles use sorted[floor(n*p)]; arm pools concatenate samples, never average percentiles.
First use means first action in a process, not a cleared shader cache.
Event timing differences are retained; gameplay equivalence does not assert timing equality.

Engine argument comparison exempts only --log-file destinations. Godot may consume recognized arguments, leaving engine_args empty; effective runtime settings are not all exposed, so verify the launch commands externally.
Verify process exit statuses, serial execution and external system conditions separately.
startup_settle follows an initial board build inside BOOT_LOAD. It is not the first cold board construction. BOOT sample273 stays roughly744–750ms for candidate versus748–792ms reference.
Godot static allocation tracking unavailable in Release. Serialized payload bytes are not decoded heap memory. Process endpoint is teardown, not gameplay.
No candidate-specific accumulating nodes observed, but this finite run does not prove absence of all leaks. Resource counts and private memory fluctuate in both arms.
Raw chronological logs, process samples and binaries remain under ignored build/board_source and build/renderer-branch; this file contains compact derived evidence only.
